market_cap.status: UNRESOLVED SOURCE CONFLICT - recorded as a spread, deliberately not averaged
market_cap.mechanism: The 2x spread is NOT a price disagreement (every source quotes 3.27) - it is a SHARE-COUNT disagreement. Pre-rights share count is 74.01M (equity capital INR 14.80 crore at INR 2 face value, unchanged FY2015-FY2025 per Screener's balance sheet). A 1:1 rights issue doubles it to ~148.02M. StockAnalysis and Investing.com are still on the pre-rights 74.01M; Screener and INDmoney are on the post-rights ~148.02M; Groww is on neither. Whichever count a terminal picks, it must state it, because the answer to 'what is this company worth' differs by 100% between two equally reputable feeds on the same day.

best_supported.rationale: 3.27 x 148,024,378 = INR 48.40 crore. The 148,024,378 figure is the only explicitly-printed share count (INDmoney) and it reconciles exactly with Screener's market cap. The 74.01M count is refuted by the FY2026 balance sheet itself, which already shows equity capital risen to INR 18.50 crore (= 92.5M shares) at 2026-03-31.
best_supported.confidence: medium-high - arithmetic-consistent across two independent sources, but NOT confirmed against a BSE shareholding/capital filing (403).

disagreement.source: derived from Screener consolidated balance sheet, equity capital INR 18.50 crore at INR 2 face value

shares_outstanding.note: THREE different counts are simultaneously defensible depending on the as-of date: 74.01M (pre-rights), 92.5M (at the FY2026 balance-sheet date), 148.02M (post full allotment). Any per-share figure computed without stating which count was used is untrustworthy for this scrip.

pe_ttm.note: Screener prints P/E as not available; StockAnalysis prints 'n/a'. Correct behaviour: the company's TTM earnings are negative, so a P/E does not exist.
pe_ttm.trap: Two of five sources render a negative P/E rather than a null. A screen that sorts ascending on P/E puts this loss-making company at the TOP as the 'cheapest' stock. The honest value is null-with-a-reason, not -10.46.

pb.note: Range 2.19x to 4.78x - a 2.2x spread on the same price, driven entirely by the book-value denominator below. Note that Screener ITSELF prints two different P/B values depending on whether the consolidated toggle is on.

book_value_per_share.mechanism: Consolidated net worth at 2026-03-31 = equity capital INR 18.50 crore + reserves INR -8.37 crore = INR 10.13 crore (reserves are NEGATIVE - accumulated losses). INR 10.13 crore / 148.02M shares = INR 0.684, which is exactly Screener's consolidated 0.68: Screener divides the OLD (balance-sheet-date) net worth by the NEW (post-rights) share count. Divide the same net worth by the 92.5M shares that actually existed at that balance-sheet date and you get INR 1.095 - close to Groww's 1.43 but not equal to it. The 2x spread is the rights issue straddling the reporting date.
book_value_per_share.trap: NEGATIVE RESERVES. This company's reserves line has been negative every single year from FY2015 to FY2026 (-2.54 to -8.37 crore). Any model that assumes reserves are additive-positive, or that computes net worth as 'equity capital + |reserves|', will roughly double the book value and halve the P/B.

face_value.corroboration: Groww prints face value INR 2 independently.
face_value.note: Relevant because the rights issue was priced AT face value (INR 2.00) - a distress-pricing signal and the lowest legally permissible rights price.

revenue_ttm.status: UNRESOLVED SOURCE CONFLICT (consolidated vs standalone vs TTM-vs-FY)
revenue_ttm.trap: SCALE UNITS. StockAnalysis and Investing.com print this in MILLIONS ('71.36M'); Screener, Groww and INDmoney print it in CRORE ('6.79 Cr'). 71.36 million = 7.136 crore. A pipeline that reads the numeral without the unit is off by 10x in one direction or the other. For a company this small, 7.136 vs 6.79 also happens to look like a plausible rounding difference while actually being a different reporting basis.
revenue_ttm.definitional_note: For a broker, 'Sales' as Screener labels it is brokerage + fee income and EXCLUDES 'Other Income' (INR 0.98 crore consolidated FY2026, which is 14% of sales and swung to 0.73 crore in the Mar-2026 quarter alone). Total income on the basis a bank/NBFC screen would use is therefore ~INR 7.88 crore, not 6.90.

consolidated_vs_standalone.status: MATERIAL - this company reports both and they differ on every headline line
consolidated_vs_standalone.note: Investing.com's profile says the company operates 'together with its subsidiaries'. Screener serves a standalone view at /company/531950/ and a consolidated view at /company/531950/consolidated/ and the two disagree on: TTM revenue (6.79 vs 6.90 INR crore), TTM net profit (-2.54 vs -2.37), EPS (-0.17 vs -0.16), book value per share (0.74 vs 0.68), P/B (4.43x vs 4.78x), ROCE (-13.4% vs -12.04%) and the 3-year ROE average (-8.61% vs -9.31%). The latest quarter differs by the largest margin: standalone net -0.49 INR crore vs consolidated net -0.40 INR crore, an 18% gap on the headline loss. INDmoney's news feed quotes the STANDALONE figure (INR 49.16 lakh loss) while its own summary tiles quote something else again. A terminal that does not label which basis it is showing will show a different loss from the one the user reads in the press release.

traps.name: Rights issue straddling the balance-sheet date
traps.detail: 1:1 rights at INR 2.00 allotted across 2026-03-31. Three share counts are simultaneously 'correct' (74.01M pre-rights, 92.5M at the FY2026 balance-sheet date, ~148.02M today). Consequence: market cap differs 2x across reputable feeds (INR 24.2 crore vs INR 48.4 crore) at an identical quoted price of INR 3.27; EPS differs 4.7x (-0.0676 to -0.32); book value differs 2x (0.68 to 1.43). An automated pipeline that joins a price feed to a stale share count produces a confidently wrong valuation with no error anywhere in the chain.

traps.name: Promoter collapse that is dilution, not a sale
traps.detail: 73.41% -> 36.44% in one quarter is exactly a halving - the signature of promoters not subscribing to a 1:1 rights issue. Any red-flag heuristic that reads a 37-percentage-point promoter drop as an exit signal will emit a true number attached to a false story. The correct reading requires joining the shareholding table to the corporate action, which no aggregator in this pack does.

traps.name: Negative reserves
traps.detail: Reserves have been NEGATIVE every year FY2015-FY2026 (-2.54 to -8.37 INR crore) - accumulated losses. Net worth is equity capital MINUS the accumulated deficit (18.50 - 8.37 = 10.13 INR crore). Any code that sums |reserves| or assumes reserves >= 0 roughly doubles book value and halves P/B.

traps.name: Negative P/E rendered as a number
traps.detail: INDmoney (-10.46) and Investing.com (-10.26) print a negative P/E where Screener and StockAnalysis correctly print null. A screener sorting ascending on P/E ranks this loss-making penny stock as the market's cheapest name. The honest value is 'does not exist because earnings are negative'.

traps.name: Null rendered as zero
traps.detail: INDmoney prints ROE 0% and ROCE 0% for a company whose actual ROE is about -22%. Zero is not missing and not negative; it passes 'ROE >= 0' filters and fails 'ROE > 0' filters, so the error is invisible in both directions.

traps.name: Crore vs million scale mixing
traps.detail: StockAnalysis and Investing.com quote this Indian scrip in MILLIONS (market cap 'INR 242.02M', revenue 'INR 71.36M'); Screener, Groww and INDmoney quote CRORE. 242.02 million = 24.202 crore. Ten-times errors are one dropped unit away, and at this company's size the wrong-unit number still looks plausible.

traps.name: Brand / legal name / domain all differ
traps.detail: Legal name 'Vertex Securities Limited'; official website vertexbroking.com; abbreviated 'Ltd' in the BSE master and on Screener; ticker VERTEX on BSE but VRTS on Investing.com. The word 'Broking' appears in the customer-facing brand and in no identifier; the word 'Securities' appears in every identifier and in no customer-facing brand. Entity extraction from news will match neither reliably.

traps.name: 'Vertex' is an occupied brand globally
traps.detail: Bare 'Vertex' resolves to Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: VRTX) in essentially all English-language finance coverage, and Investing.com's own alias for this scrip is VRTS - one character from VRTX. Any news or web-search step keyed on the bare word will return US biotech coverage for an INR 48 crore Kerala broker.

traps.name: Headquarters disagreement across three cities
traps.detail: Company's own registered office and its CIN state code say KOCHI, KERALA. Groww says Bengaluru, Karnataka. Investing.com says Mumbai. Investing.com additionally states a founding year of 1987 against the CIN's 1993 and the company's own 33rd AGM. A profile panel that trusts an aggregator will print a wrong state, a wrong city and a wrong founding year.

traps.name: Broker ratios computed with manufacturing formulas
traps.detail: Screener reports debtor days of 539.60 (FY2023) and working-capital days of -745.85 (FY2022) for a stock broker whose balance sheet carries client dues and exchange margins. 'Other liabilities' of INR 19.86 crore on a INR 35.97 crore balance sheet is float, not trade payables. Sales excludes Other Income (INR 0.98 crore, 14% of sales in FY2026, of which 0.73 crore landed in a single quarter) - so 'revenue' for this company is a definitional choice, not a fact.

traps.name: NSE membership is not an NSE listing
traps.detail: The company holds NSE trading membership code 13248 and MCX membership 57160 and advertises them on its own site, while the SHARE is BSE-only (no NSE URL in Screener's Links section). The company-site 'BSE Code' is 3188 (trading member), not 531950 (scrip). A resolver scraping identifiers from company material gets the wrong numbers and may invent an NSE listing.

traps.detail: 52-week high splits 3-2: 4.59 (Screener, Groww, INDmoney) vs 4.96 (StockAnalysis, Investing.com) - and the split falls on exactly the same line as the pre/post-rights share count. Consistent with one camp adjusting the historical series for the INR 2.00 rights issue and the other not. The 52-week LOW (2.26) is unanimous, so a differ cannot detect this by checking one bound.

traps.name: Sign error inside a single source
traps.detail: INDmoney's summary tile reports Jun-2026 net profit of +INR 0.40 crore ('loss improvement of 72.22% QoQ') while INDmoney's own news block for the same quarter reports a standalone LOSS of INR 49.16 lakh. One page, two signs. Cross-source agreement checks that treat a source as internally consistent will not catch this.

traps.name: Penny price on a two-rupee face value
traps.detail: At INR 3.27 the stock trades at 1.6x face value and one tick is a material percentage move (the 2026-09-18 close was +4.14% on a INR 0.13 move). Turnover was ~38,100 shares, about INR 1.25 lakh. Percentage-change formatting, sparkline scaling and 'significant move' thresholds all need to behave at this magnitude, and a group-X scrip may simply not trade on a given day.

traps.name: Fiscal-year labelling
traps.detail: Indian FY2026 = year ended 2026-03-31. The quarter ended 2026-06-30 is Q1 FY27 to a domestic source and 'Jun 2026' or even 'Q1 FY26' to others - INDmoney's news block literally labels the Jun-2026 quarter 'Q1 FY26'. Quarter-label joins across sources will mismatch by a full year.
